youtube.title: The 1886 Rumour That Liberty Was Built for Egypt #Shorts
youtube.description:
The month the Statue of Liberty was unveiled, American papers printed a rumour that she was first made for the Suez Canal. The same paragraph answered it.

Full video: "Was the Statue of Liberty Built for Egypt?" https://youtu.be/Rv1KqxNFrKI

Every picture is real. The narration is an AI-generated (synthetic) voice. Sources and full credits are in the full video's description.
Newspaper: Springfield Weekly Republican, 15 Oct 1886, p. 2. Library of Congress, Chronicling America.
